summary: Carey voted Yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, directing use of the IHRA definition in education-discrimination enforcement. Vote for Peace, a guide rating candidates on human rights and war-lobby funding, opposed him in the general. In October 2025 he backed ending the Gaza war but framed it as a response to the October 7 Hamas attack, praising the President's ceasefire leadership. In May 2025 he cosponsored a resolution condemning antisemitism and honoring two Israeli embassy employees killed in Washington.
